/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import re
p=Path('index.html'); html=p.read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.refs=[]; self.stack=[]; self.errors=[]; self.tags=Counter()
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs);self.tags[tag]+=1
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if a.get('href','').startswith('#') and len(a['href'])>1:self.refs.append(a['href'][1:])
  if tag not in ['area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr','path','use','rect','circle']:self.stack.append(tag)
 def handle_endtag(self,tag):
  if tag in ['path','use','rect','circle']:return
  if not self.stack or self.stack[-1]"'!=tag:self.errors.append((tag,self.stack[-3:]));return
  self.stack.pop()
c=Check(); c.feed(html)
print('"'Size:',len(html),'bytes')
print('Duplicate IDs:',[k for k,v in Counter(c.ids).items() if v>1])
print('Unmatched tags:',c.errors,'Unclosed:',c.stack)
print('Broken anchors:',sorted(set(c.refs)-set(c.ids)))
print('FAQs:',c.tags['details'],'Features:',html.count('class=\"feature\"'),'Plans:',html.count('class=\"price-card'))
print('Remote images:', bool(re.search(r'<img|url\\(\\s*[\\'\"]?https?://',html)))
Path('/private/tmp/rotaline-script.js').write_text(re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',html,re.S).group(1))
PY
node --check /private/tmp/rotaline-script.js"
